name: Glute bridge
summary: Lie on your back with knees bent and lift your hips until your body is straight from knees to shoulders. Trains the glutes with almost no load on the back.
setup: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat and hip width apart. Your heels sit about a hand length from your glutes, so your fingertips can just touch them.
Arms on the floor by your sides, palms down.
Press your lower back gently toward the floor by tightening your abs. This tilts your pelvis slightly back.

steps.text: Breathe in. Keep the ribs down and the slight pelvic tuck.
Push through your heels and lift your hips. Breathe out as you rise.
Stop when your knees, hips and shoulders make a straight line. Squeeze your glutes hard for one to two seconds.
Lower your hips slowly, one vertebra at a time, until they lightly touch the floor.

jointCues.cue: Tucked slightly under, as if pulling your belt buckle toward your ribs.
jointCues.why: The tuck keeps the work in the glutes. Arching the lower back at the top shifts it to the back muscles.

jointCues.cue: Down. Do not let your ribs flare up at the top.
jointCues.why: Flared ribs mean the lower back is arching to fake the last part of the lift.

jointCues.cue: Hip width, pointing straight ahead. Do not let them fall in.
jointCues.why: Knees that cave in turn off the side glutes.

jointCues.cue: Weight in the heels; you could lift your toes.
jointCues.why: Pushing through the toes shifts the work to the quadriceps.

breathing: Breathe in at the bottom, breathe out as you lift, breathe normally during the hold, breathe in as you lower.
tempo: 1 s up, 2 s hold, 2 s down

mistakes.fault: Arching the lower back at the top
mistakes.fix: Stop when knees, hips and shoulders are in line; keep the ribs down.

mistakes.fault: Feeling it mostly in the hamstrings
mistakes.fix: Bring your feet a little closer to your glutes.
Push your knees gently outward, or loop a band above the knees.

cues.text: Top: knees, hips and shoulders in one straight line
Squeeze the glutes; belt buckle toward the ribs
